ingredients: 1 large ripe mango, peeled, pitted and diced
1 small cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced
2 to 3 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro (or more to taste)
24 wonton sheets (1 package; available at supermarkets or specialty stores)
steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Lightly coat mini-muffin pans with cooking spray and line the molds with wonton sheets.
Bake for 9 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Let the wonton cups cool.
Mix remaining ingredients plus pepper to taste.
Fill each wonton with salsa and serve.
quickIngredients: 1 large ripe mango, peeled, pitted and diced
1 small cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced
mango-salsa-wontons.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Lightly coat mini-muffin pans with cooking spray and line the molds with wonton sheets.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons light or low-fat cream cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 375° F.
Put artichoke hearts in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium and cook for 6 minutes.
Drain and rinse with cold water to cool.
Chop artichoke hearts.
In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese, hot sauce and garlic.
Move mixture to a baking dish. Top with Parmesan cheese.
Put in oven and bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly on top.
artichoke-dip.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 375° F. Put artichoke hearts in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil.
artichoke-dip.notes: If using canned or a jar of artichokes instead of frozen, look for the lowest-sodium brand. Rinse well to help reduce sodium.
artichoke-dip.servingSuggestion: Try this dip on toasted slices of baguette, crisp celery or with your favorite low-sodium crackers.

ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled and finely chopped
steps: Mix all ingredients in bowl.
Let stand for 20 minutes.
quickIngredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled and finely chopped
fresh-tzatziki.quickMethod: Mix all ingredients in bowl. Let stand for 20 minutes.
fresh-tzatziki.servingSuggestion: Serve with fresh vegetables, such as cucumbers, broccoli and carrots. Use as a dressing for salad or as a spread for a sandwich. Leftovers will keep in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 days.

ingredients: 4 medium carrots, peeled and finely diced
2 large (11 to 12 inches) stalks of celery, finely diced
1 large red bell pepper, seeded and finely diced
1 can (8 ounces) water chestnuts, drained and finely diced
3 medium scallions (white and green parts), thinly sliced
2 tablespoons fresh ginger, grated or finely minced
1 pound ground chicken (at least 90 percent lean)
1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce (or to taste)
1/4 cup minced fresh cilantro, plus extra for garnish
steps: Liberally coat a large skillet with cooking spray and preheat over medium-high heat.
Add the carrots, celery, bell pepper, water chestnuts, scallions, ginger and garlic.
Sauté, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables soften slightly, about 5 minutes. Add a tablespoon of water as necessary to prevent scorching.
Reapply cooking spray, if necessary, and add the ground chicken to the skillet.
Cook until the chicken is no longer pink, breaking the meat into a fine crumble with a wooden spoon as it cooks.
Season with pepper.
Add the plum sauce, soy sauce, vinegar and chili paste. Stir to coat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer until heated through.
Take the skillet from heat and stir in cilantro.
Let the mixture cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Clean the lettuce and break off 12 individual leaves.
quickIngredients: 4 medium carrots, peeled and finely diced
2 large (11 to 12 inches) stalks of celery, finely diced
chicken-lettuce-wraps.quickMethod: Liberally coat a large skillet with cooking spray and preheat over medium-high heat. Add the carrots, celery, bell pepper, water chestnuts, scallions, ginger and garlic.
chicken-lettuce-wraps.notes: When gathering the lettuce leaves, trim away the stem end of the leaves if they are tough.
chicken-lettuce-wraps.servingSuggestion: Fill each lettuce cup with 1/2 cup of the chicken mixture. Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.

ingredients: 1 pound 85 percent or leaner ground beef
1/4 cup liquid reduced-fat or low-fat nondairy creamer
1/2 cup fresh or frozen cranberries, finely chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 375° F.
Lightly coat a small saucepan with cooking spray and place over medium heat.
Add onion and sauté until tender.
Mix onion with next 6 ingredients in a bowl.
Shape into 36 1-inch meatballs.
Lightly coat a jelly roll pan or shallow baking dish with cooking spray.
Put meatballs in pan and bake for 18 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare sauce by combining the cranberries and remaining ingredients in a small saucepan.
Cook over medium heat until heated through.
Move meatballs to a serving dish and pour sauce over meatballs. Serve with toothpicks.
quickIngredients: 1 pound 85 percent or leaner ground beef
sweet-and-spicy-meatballs.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 375° F. Lightly coat a small saucepan with cooking spray and place over medium heat.
sweet-and-spicy-meatballs.servingSuggestion: Pair with some vegetables and dip to reduce the dietary acids, and you have the makings of a PKD-friendly appetizer!

ingredients: 1 package (8 ounces) light or low-fat cream cheese, softened
1/8 teaspoon black pepper Cayenne pepper to taste
steps: Heat the oven to 375° F.
Put softened cream cheese in a bowl.
Add onion, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper and cayenne pepper. Mix well.
Stir in nondairy creamer.
Add crab meat and stir until blended.
Put mixture into an oven-safe dish.
Bake uncovered for 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
quickIngredients: 1 package (8 ounces) light or low-fat cream cheese, softened
hot-crab-dip.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 375° F. Put softened cream cheese in a bowl.

ingredients: 2 medium bell peppers, any color, diced
1/2 cup of your favorite low-sodium cheese, shredded
steps: Spread ingredients in 9” x 11” baking pan.
Layer 1: refried black beans
Layer 2: Mash together: 3 ripe avocados, lemon juice and mayonnaise
Layer 3: Mix sour cream, cilantro and low-sodium taco seasoning
Layer 4: bell peppers
Layer 5: shredded cheese
Layer 6: shredded lettuce
Layer 7: diced plum tomato and onion
mexican-layer-dip.quickMethod: Spread ingredients in 9” x 11” baking pan. Layer 1: refried black beans
mexican-layer-dip.notes: Substitute Homemade Salt-Free Mexican Spice Mix on page 103 for the low-sodium taco seasoning, and make your own light mayonnaise with the recipe on page 104. For low-sodium cheese, we suggest Monterey jack or low-sodium versions of cheddar or pepper jack. You can also mix a blend for variety.
mexican-layer-dip.servingSuggestion: The joy in this dish is how much you can personalize it to your taste. If you don't like something, just leave it out. Is it missing your favorite taco ingredient? Add it in and make it your own. Serve with raw vegetables such as baby carrots, broccoli florets and cauliflower florets, salt-free tortilla chips or tortillas cut into triangles.

ingredients: 2/3 cup dry or 1 1/2 cups cooked and drained garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
steps: Beans: Place beans in a large bowl and cover with several inches of cold water. They will double in size during soaking, so be sure to use a large enough bowl to accommodate.
Discard any floating beans.
Cover the bowl with a clean towel and let soak overnight. Drain and rinse before cooking. Place beans in large pot and cover with water (about 1 quart of water for each cup of soaked beans).
Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer.
Cook for 60 to 90 minutes until tender. Watch water level as you cook, you may need to add more water.
Drain in colander and allow to cool.
Put cooked and drained beans in airtight container or sealable bag (keep liquid out). They will keep in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 days.
Hummus: Mash cooked garbanzo beans into thick paste.
Add the rest of the ingredients and stir together.
If consistency is too thick, add a bit more lemon juice.
quickIngredients: 2/3 cup dry or 1 1/2 cups cooked and drained garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
hummus.quickMethod: Beans: Place beans in a large bowl and cover with several inches of cold water. They will double in size during soaking, so be sure to use a large enough bowl to accommodate. Discard any floating beans.
hummus.notes: Using dried garbanzo beans, rather than canned, allows you to better control the salt content. Consider cooking a large batch and freezing the extras for use next time. To freeze, pat dry with a paper towel before adding to a sealable bag. Frozen garbanzos will keep for about a year. Hummus requires quite tender beans, but they freeze better when they are firmer. You may want to remove a portion to freeze and continue cooking the rest.
hummus.servingSuggestion: Serve with fresh pita bread and fresh vegetables such as cucumbers, broccoli and carrots for a snack.

ingredients: ¼ cup low-sodium or no-salt-added tomato paste
1 pound fresh medium shrimp (16 to 20 count), peeled, deveined
steps: Mix tomato paste, garlic and chili powder in small bowl.
Spray wok or large skillet with cooking spray; heat on high 1 minute.
Add shrimp, stirring frequently; cook 5 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.
Add tomato paste mixture; toss to evenly coat shrimp.
quickIngredients: ¼ cup low-sodium or no-salt-added tomato paste
chili-lime-shrimp.quickMethod: Mix tomato paste, garlic and chili powder in small bowl. Spray wok or large skillet with cooking spray; heat on high 1 minute.
chili-lime-shrimp.notes: Use fresh shrimp, as frozen are often high in sodium.
chili-lime-shrimp.servingSuggestion: Divide shrimp evenly among 4 serving plates. Squeeze 1 lime wedge over shrimp on each plate before serving. Serve with additional lime wedges. To reduce the acids from the meat, pair with some vegetable sides or fresh fruit.

ingredients: 1 baguette about 26 inches long, cut into 1/2-inch diagonal slices, toasted
1 can (14 1/2 ounces) low-sodium or no-salt-added petite diced tomatoes
steps: Combine all ingredients, except baguette slices, in a saucepan.
Season with pepper to taste; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and let simmer for 10 minutes.
easy-bruschetta.quickMethod: Combine all ingredients, except baguette slices, in a saucepan. Season with pepper to taste; bring to a boil.
easy-bruschetta.servingSuggestion: Serve at room temperature on toasted baguette slices. ups and lads Eggplant Vegetable Soup 47 Turkey Vegetable Soup 48 Ginger Pork Soup 49 Creamy Carrot Thyme Soup 50 Beef Chili 51 Strawberry Spinach Salad 53 Roasted Corn and Edamame Salad 54 Summertime Salad 55 Zucchini-Ribbon Salad 56 Mandarin Salad 57 Chipotle Chicken Salad 58 Spinach, Apple and Walnut Salad 59 Mexican Vegetable Salad 60 Fall Harvest Orzo Salad 61 Eggplant Vegetable Soup WELL

ingredients: 1 can (28 ounces) low-sodium or no-salt-added crushed tomatoes with liquid
28 ounces low-sodium or no-salt-added beef broth
3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese for garnish
steps: In a pot, brown turkey.
Add onions, celery, carrots, tomatoes and broth.
Stir well.
Add eggplant and spices; simmer for 30 minutes.
Add macaroni, cook 10 minutes longer, until macaroni is done.
Add parsley.
Serve sprinkled with cheese.
eggplant-vegetable-soup.quickMethod: In a pot, brown turkey. Add onions, celery, carrots, tomatoes and broth.
eggplant-vegetable-soup.servingSuggestion: This hearty soup is loaded with healthy vegetables. Want it as a side dish instead? Considering making it without the meat.

ingredients: 2 pounds cooked 93 percent lean ground turkey
steps: Melt butter in pot over medium-high heat.
Add onions and sauté until translucent, approximately 10 minutes.
Stir in flour and curry powder, cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Add broth, potatoes, carrots, celery, parsley and sage.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add turkey, milk and spinach.
Cover and simmer until heated through.
Add pepper to taste.
turkey-vegetable-soup.quickMethod: Melt butter in pot over medium-high heat. Add onions and sauté until translucent, approximately 10 minutes.
turkey-vegetable-soup.servingSuggestion: Having this soup, along with a small salad topped with your favorite vegetables, is a vegetable medley that'll certainly help protect your kidneys.

ingredients: 12 ounces lean boneless pork, cut into thin pieces
32 ounces low-sodium chicken broth or see Basic Chicken Stock recipe on page 108
steps: Add oil to large saucepan, warm on medium heat.
Add pork and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly pink in the center.
Take pork from pan and set aside.
Add mushrooms and garlic to saucepan and cook until tender.
Stir in broth, sherry, soy sauce, ginger and red pepper and bring to a boil.
Stir in pork, Chinese cabbage and green onion.
Heat until hot throughout.
quickIngredients: 12 ounces lean boneless pork, cut into thin pieces
ginger-pork-soup.quickMethod: Add oil to large saucepan, warm on medium heat. Add pork and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly pink in the center.
ginger-pork-soup.servingSuggestion: Try pairing with a side salad for a light dinner.

ingredients: 3 pounds baby carrots or carrot chunks, peeled
8 cups low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth (see page 108 for recipe)
steps: Mix the carrots, stock and thyme in a pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Take from heat and transfer the soup in 2 batches to a blender.
Puree the soup completely.
Stir in the honey and cream.
Add pepper, as desired.
Serve while warm.
quickIngredients: 3 pounds baby carrots or carrot chunks, peeled
8 cups low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth (see page 108 for recipe)
creamy-carrot-thyme-soup.quickMethod: Mix the carrots, stock and thyme in a pot. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

ingredients: 1 large (11 to 12 inches) stalk of celery
1 1/2 pounds 85 percent or leaner ground beef
steps: Chop onion, celery and bell pepper.
Heat large skillet on medium heat. Add oil, onion, celery and bell pepper. Cook until tender but not brown.
Add ground beef, breaking into small pieces, and cook until brown.
Blend tomatoes in a blender and add to beef mixture.
Add chili powder and water. Mix thoroughly; reduce heat to low.
Simmer for several hours.
quickIngredients: 1 large (11 to 12 inches) stalk of celery
beef-chili.quickMethod: Chop onion, celery and bell pepper. Heat large skillet on medium heat. Add oil, onion, celery and bell pepper. Cook until tender but not brown.
beef-chili.servingSuggestion: This beef chili is far healthier than the canned products you find at the store. Serve with some roasted vegetables or mixed vegetables to top off the meal. WELL

steps: Wash and dry the spinach leaves.
Tear into bite-size pieces and place in a bowl.
Top spinach with sliced strawberries.
In a separate bowl, mix together the vinegar, lemon juice, honey, dry mustard and oil.
Pour dressing over spinach and strawberries.
Toss well and serve immediately.
strawberry-spinach-salad.quickMethod: Wash and dry the spinach leaves. Tear into bite-size pieces and place in a bowl.

ingredients: 1/4 cup red bell pepper, diced small
1 1/2 teaspoon ginger, finely chopped or grated
steps: Soak fresh corn in cold water about 30 minutes.
Heat grill on high.
Grill corn in husk, 10 to 15 minutes, turning once.
Let cool and remove husks.
Cut corn from cob into a bowl.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve.
roasted-corn-and-edamame-salad.quickMethod: Soak fresh corn in cold water about 30 minutes. Heat grill on high.
roasted-corn-and-edamame-salad.notes: Edamame should be cooked prior to chilling in the refrigerator. Frozen varieties may be pre-cooked prior to packaging. Check package for details.

ingredients: 6 cups spring lettuce mix, loosely packed
¼ cup red onion, thinly sliced
steps: Mix vinegar, sugar, onion, dry mustard, salt, mayonnaise and orange juice in a food processor.
Process to blend well.
With processor still on, add vegetable oil in a steady stream and continue processing until incorporated.
Add poppy seeds and pulse briefly until just blended.
Move to airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use.
Add salad ingredients to a bowl.
Drizzle with vinaigrette, toss to combine.
quickIngredients: 6 cups spring lettuce mix, loosely packed
summertime-salad.quickMethod: Mix vinegar, sugar, onion, dry mustard, salt, mayonnaise and orange juice in a food processor. Process to blend well.

steps: Peel long ribbons of the zucchini and squash.
In a large bowl, whisk together the remaining ingredients.
Add the zucchini and squash, and toss to mix well.
Season to taste with freshly ground pepper.
zucchini-ribbon-salad.quickMethod: Peel long ribbons of the zucchini and squash. In a large bowl, whisk together the remaining ingredients.

ingredients: 1 cup mandarin oranges, packed in water or juice
2 tablespoons sugar substitute (Splenda, or can use sugar)
3 to 5 strips low-sodium bacon or turkey bacon, cooked and crumbled
steps: Mix salad ingredients.
In a separate bowl, mix ingredients for dressing in the order they are listed.
Toss salad with dressing just before serving.
quickIngredients: 1 cup mandarin oranges, packed in water or juice
mandarin-salad.quickMethod: Mix salad ingredients. In a separate bowl, mix ingredients for dressing in the order they are listed.

ingredients: 1/2 cup light or homemade mayonnaise (see page 104 for recipe)
2 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Mix well.
chipotle-chicken-salad.quickMethod: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Mix well.
chipotle-chicken-salad.servingSuggestion: Serve on lettuce leaves, low-salt crackers or bread roll. Don't forget to pair with a side of mixed fruit or grapes to make sure you keep your dietary acid load low.

ingredients: 2 large apples (Golden Delicious or other favorite), cored, diced large
steps: Toss apples with 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice.
Put spinach in a large bowl; remove long stems and bruised leaves.
Whisk together remaining juice, olive oil, vinegar, honey and ground pepper to taste.
Toss spinach with apples and dressing.
quickIngredients: 2 large apples (Golden Delicious or other favorite), cored, diced large
spinach-apple-and-walnut-salad.quickMethod: Toss apples with 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice. Put spinach in a large bowl; remove long stems and bruised leaves.
spinach-apple-and-walnut-salad.servingSuggestion: Divide among 4 bowls. Top with cheese and walnuts.

ingredients: 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into chunks
2 large (11 to 12 inches) stalks of celery, chopped
steps: Mix vegetables in a bowl.
Sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Dress salad with hot sauce, lime juice and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve chilled.
mexican-vegetable-salad.quickMethod: Mix vegetables in a bowl. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro.

ingredients: 4 cups cooked orzo, chilled (about 1 2/3 cup dried orzo)
steps: Prepare the orzo as directed on the packaging.
In a medium bowl, add all of the ingredients except blue cheese and almonds, gently combining until well incorporated.
Move the mixture to a serving dish, sprinkle with the crumbled blue cheese and almonds and serve.
quickIngredients: 4 cups cooked orzo, chilled (about 1 2/3 cup dried orzo)
fall-harvest-orzo-salad.quickMethod: Prepare the orzo as directed on the packaging. In a medium bowl, add all of the ingredients except blue cheese and almonds, gently combining until well incorporated.

ingredients: 1/2 cup low-sodium white beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Dice potatoes and steam until just tender (about 10 minutes). Set aside.
Wash and remove stems from kale, then chop into 1/2-inch slices.
In nonstick skillet, heat oil on medium.
Add onion, garlic and thyme; sauté until onion is soft (about 3 minutes).
Add kale and tomato, sauté for an additional 1 to 2 minutes or until kale has wilted.
Add potatoes and beans, stir until mixed and warm throughout.
Season with pepper to taste and serve immediately.
warm-potato-and-kale-mix.quickMethod: Dice potatoes and steam until just tender (about 10 minutes). Set aside. Wash and remove stems from kale, then chop into 1/2-inch slices.

ingredients: 6 medium sweet potatoes (about 2 1/4 pounds) Vegetable cooking spray
steps: Heat the oven to 500° F.
Peel potatoes; cut lengthwise.
Put in a large bowl; coat with cooking spray.
Mix sugar, salt and peppers and sprinkle over potatoes, tossing well to coat.
Arrange potatoes, cut sides down, in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes; turn wedges over.
Bake an additional 10 minutes or until tender and beginning to brown.
quickIngredients: 6 medium sweet potatoes (about 2 1/4 pounds) Vegetable cooking spray
spicy-sweet-potato-fries.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 500° F. Peel potatoes; cut lengthwise.

ingredients: 2 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes (about 6), peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
steps: Put the potatoes and garlic in a large saucepan and cover with water.
Bring to a boil; cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until a fork easily pierces a potato.
Drain the potatoes and garlic.
Mash with a potato masher or a fork until smooth.
Blend in the milk, butter, parsley, scallions, Parmesan and salt.
Gently fold in the tomatoes.
quickIngredients: 2 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes (about 6), peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
mashed-tomato-potatoes.quickMethod: Put the potatoes and garlic in a large saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until a fork easily pierces a potato.

ingredients: 4 large sweet potatoes, par-cooked and cut into 1/2-inch slices
1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, coarsely chopped
steps: Preheat grill to high.
Brush potatoes and scallions with oil, and arrange on grill.
Grill potatoes for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, or until just tender.
Grill scallions until softened and marked.
Take scallions from the grill and cut into thin slices.
In a large bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup olive oil, mustard, vinegars and honey. Season with pepper to taste.
Add potatoes, scallions and parsley, and toss until potatoes are well coated.
Move to a platter and serve. WELL
quickIngredients: 4 large sweet potatoes, par-cooked and cut into 1/2-inch slices
grilled-sweet-potatoes-and-scallions.quickMethod: Preheat grill to high. Brush potatoes and scallions with oil, and arrange on grill.

ingredients: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, rinsed, ends trimmed, rough outer leaves of larger sprouts removed
steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Put Brussels sprouts in a cast-iron frying pan or a roasting pan.
Toss in the garlic.
Sprinkle Brussels sprouts with lemon juice.
Toss with oil so that the sprouts are well coated.
Sprinkle generously with salt (at least a 1/2 teaspoon) and a few turns of black pepper mill.
Put Brussels sprouts in oven on top rack, cook for 20 minutes, then stir to coat sprouts with the oil in the pan.
Cook for another 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan (if using) and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve warm.
quickIngredients: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, rinsed, ends trimmed, rough outer leaves of larger sprouts removed
roasted-brussels-sprouts.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Put Brussels sprouts in a cast-iron frying pan or a roasting pan.
roasted-brussels-sprouts.notes: Adjust the timing depending on the size of the sprouts. They should be nicely browned, some of the outside leaves crunchy, and the interior should be cooked through. If the sprouts look like they are getting too brown (they should be well browned, not burned), move them to a lower rack or reduce the heat.

ingredients: 1/4 pound fresh part-skim or low-fat mozzarella, cut into 4 half-inch-thick slices
steps: Preheat grill.
In small bowl, mix all of the dressing ingredients together and set aside.
Brush asparagus with olive oil mixture, and season with pepper to taste.
Grill for 3 to 4 minutes or until just tender.
Divide the asparagus among 4 plates and immediately top with a slice of mozzarella.
grilled-asparagus-with-mozzarella.quickMethod: Preheat grill. In small bowl, mix all of the dressing ingredients together and set aside.

ingredients: 1 medium onion, cut into large chunks
1 medium zucchini, cut into thick slices
1 medium yellow squash, cut into thick slices
1 small sweet potato, cut into small cubes
steps: Put all vegetables in large bowl.
Mix oil, garlic, salt and pepper in small bowl and pour over vegetables. Stir until all vegetables are coated.
Arrange vegetables on flat baking sheet or grill basket. Cook on medium-high grill until vegetables are cooked and just starting to brown, approximately 10 to 20 minutes.
Serve immediately.
quickIngredients: 1 medium onion, cut into large chunks
1 medium zucchini, cut into thick slices
1 medium yellow squash, cut into thick slices
grilled-vegetables.quickMethod: Put all vegetables in large bowl. Mix oil, garlic, salt and pepper in small bowl and pour over vegetables. Stir until all vegetables are coated.
grilled-vegetables.notes: Cover the baking sheet with foil for easy cleaning. Make it your own by using any vegetables you like.

ingredients: 6 ounces light or reduced-fat cream cheese
steps: Mix 1/4 cup butter, parsley flakes and basil.
Blend cream cheese and pepper in with butter mixture.
Stir in 2/3 cup boiling water. Blend mixture well.
Keep warm over pan of hot water.
Cook noodles in unsalted water until just tender; drain.
Cook minced garlic in 1/4 cup butter for 1 to 2 minutes, then pour over noodles, tossing lightly and quickly to coat well.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese; toss again.
Pile noodles on warm serving platter.
Spoon warm cream cheese sauce over noodles.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Garnish with additional parsley.
noodles-romano.quickMethod: Mix 1/4 cup butter, parsley flakes and basil. Blend cream cheese and pepper in with butter mixture.
noodles-romano.servingSuggestion: A dish worthy of an entree, but make sure to serve with some type of vegetables on the side to balance out the acids from the cheese.

ingredients: 1 can (16 ounces) low-sodium black beans, drained and rinsed (rinse twice to reduce sodium)
1 medium red bell pepper, chopped into chunks
steps: Warm the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add rinsed quinoa and toast for 2 to 3 minutes until it starts to smell nutty.
Add water, stir once, cover and simmer with a lid for 20 minutes.
While quinoa is cooking, prepare dressing by combining the lime juice, oil and cumin. Whisk aggressively. Adjust seasoning to taste.
When the quinoa is finished, remove from heat and fluff with a fork. Add black beans and toss to warm through.
Let the quinoa cool for about 5 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and dressing, mix, and adjust the seasoning if needed.
quinoa-with-black-beans-and-avocado.quickMethod: Warm the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add rinsed quinoa and toast for 2 to 3 minutes until it starts to smell nutty. Add water, stir once, cover and simmer with a lid for 20 minutes.

ingredients: 2 medium red bell peppers, seeded and diced
1 small sweet potato, peeled and cubed
steps: Heat the oven to 475° F.
In a large bowl, combine the squash, red bell peppers, sweet potato and Yukon Gold potatoes. Separate red onion quarters into pieces and add them to the mixture.
In a small bowl, stir together thyme, rosemary, olive oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Toss oil mixture with vegetables until they are coated.
Spread evenly on a large pan.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes in the oven, stirring every 10 minutes or until vegetables are cooked through and browned.
quickIngredients: 2 medium red bell peppers, seeded and diced
1 small sweet potato, peeled and cubed
roasted-vegetables.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 475° F. In a large bowl, combine the squash, red bell peppers, sweet potato and Yukon Gold potatoes. Separate red onion quarters into pieces and add them to the mixture.

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
6 ounces zucchini, quartered lengthwise, then sliced across thinly
6 ounces yellow squash, quartered lengthwise, then sliced across thinly
1 cup cherry tomatoes, cut in half
15 ounces canned low-sodium garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
4 ounces low-fat or reduced-fat crumbled feta cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Lightly coat a small baking dish with cooking spray.
Bring the broth to a boil in a saucepan, add the couscous, cover the pan and remove it from the heat.
Meanwhile, boil water in a large pot. Cut the stems and top 1/2-inch off the bell peppers; scoop out the seeds and membranes. Boil trimmed peppers for 5 minutes, then drain them upside down.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet. Add onion, zucchini, yellow squash, fennel seeds and oregano.
Cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes or until softened.
Take the skillet off the heat, then fold in the tomatoes and garbanzo beans.
Using a fork, scrape the couscous into the skillet and toss with o the vegetables. w a
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese. i s
Put peppers upright in the baking dish and fill them with couscous.
Bake 15 minutes. Serve immediately.
quickIngredients: 1 1/4 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
couscous-and-feta-stuffed-peppers.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Lightly coat a small baking dish with cooking spray.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice wine or white vinegar
1 teaspoon jalapeño pepper, seeded and minced
4 salmon steaks (4 ounces each) or fillets, about 1 to
steps: For salsa, combine all ingredients except the salmon in a small bowl.
Cover and chill at least 30 minutes.
Lightly coat grill or broiler pan with cooking spray.
Sprinkle both sides of salmon with pepper.
Grill or broil for 5 minutes on each side or until done.
Top each salmon steak with 1/4 cup salsa.
grilled-salmon-with-papaya-mint-salsa.quickMethod: For salsa, combine all ingredients except the salmon in a small bowl. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes.
grilled-salmon-with-papaya-mint-salsa.servingSuggestion: Pair with whole-wheat couscous and side salad or fruit dish.

ingredients: 6 ounces 90 percent extra-lean ground round beef
3 medium green apples, peeled, cored and grated
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high.
Mix beef, pork, rosemary, sage and salt in a medium-size bowl; form into 4 patties.
In a small bowl, combine chive mayo ingredients.
In a medium bowl, combine slaw ingredients.
Grill patties 4 minutes on each side or until juices run clear.
Toast the buns and spread each top with the chive mayo. Place burger on bun, then top with slaw and several spinach leaves.
quickIngredients: 6 ounces 90 percent extra-lean ground round beef
rosemary-sage-burger-with-apple-slaw-and.quickMethod: Preheat grill to medium-high. Mix beef, pork, rosemary, sage and salt in a medium-size bowl; form into 4 patties.
rosemary-sage-burger-with-apple-slaw-and.servingSuggestion: Baked fries will help balance out the acids in the burger.

ingredients: 3 medium peaches (firm but ripe), pitted and wedged
1/2 cup dry white wine or white wine vinegar
1/4 teaspoon fresh rosemary, chopped plus 1 to 2 additional springs
steps: Preheat grill to high.
Pat pork dry and season with pepper (and salt lightly, if you wish).
Grill pork on lightly oiled grill until marked, about 10 minutes on each side.
While the meat is cooking, combine peaches, wine/vinegar, brown sugar and water in a saucepan.
Peel strips of lemon skin into pan and squeeze in the juice.
Cover and cook on medium to high heat until peaches are tender, about 5 minutes.
Move solid ingredients to another bowl with a slotted spoon.
Add mustard, pinch of salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper to the juice in the pan.

Reserve 1/3 cup of the cooking liquid, mix it with the chopped rosemary, and brush it over the pork. Grill for another 10 to 15 minutes, until the thickest part reaches 145° F, then move the pork to a cutting board to rest.
Simmer remaining liquid in saucepan for a few minutes until it t b thickens; remove from heat, add peaches and rosemary sprigs.
Slice pork and serve with peach sauce.
peach-pork-tenderloin.quickMethod: Preheat grill to high. Pat pork dry and season with pepper (and salt lightly, if you wish).

ingredients: 1/4 cup red bell pepper, finely chopped
steps: In small bowl, make marinade by mixing soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, pineapple juice and apple cider vinegar.
Measure out 2 tablespoons and set aside for pineapple salsa.
Put salmon in large resealable plastic bag or glass dish. Add the rest of the marinade minus 2 tablespoons (held aside); turn to coat well. Refrigerate 15 minutes or longer for extra flavor.
Make pineapple salsa by mixing 2 tablespoons of the marinade, pineapple, bell pepper, cilantro and onion in small bowl until well blended.
Take salmon from marinade. Discard remaining marinade.
Grill salmon over medium-high heat 6 to 7 minutes per side or until fish flakes easily with a fork, brushing with remaining 2 tablespoons marinade halfway through cooking.
Serve salmon with pineapple salsa.
salmon-with-pineapple-salsa.quickMethod: In small bowl, make marinade by mixing soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, pineapple juice and apple cider vinegar. Measure out 2 tablespoons and set aside for pineapple salsa.

ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cubed
4 whole-grain buns Toppings: Avocado, spicy mustard, greens and tomato
steps: Cook potato and mash together with black beans.
Add the onion, vinegar, garlic powder, chili powder, salt, flour and greens; continue to mash with a fork.
Form into 4 patties and coat with panko.
Fry in pan and serve with toppings of your choice.
quickIngredients: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cubed
sweet-potato-burgers.quickMethod: Cook potato and mash together with black beans. Add the onion, vinegar, garlic powder, chili powder, salt, flour and greens; continue to mash with a fork.

steps: In a medium glass bowl, prepare marinade by mixing garlic, light olive oil, basil, salt, pepper, lemon juice and parsley.
Put salmon fillets in a medium glass baking dish and cover with the marinade.
Marinate in the refrigerator about 1 hour, turning occasionally.
Heat the oven to 375° F.
Put fillets in aluminum foil, cover with marinade and seal.
Put sealed salmon in the glass dish and bake 35 to 45 minutes, until easily flaked with a fork.
baked-salmon.quickMethod: In a medium glass bowl, prepare marinade by mixing garlic, light olive oil, basil, salt, pepper, lemon juice and parsley. Put salmon fillets in a medium glass baking dish and cover with the marinade.

ingredients: 1 tablespoon celery leaves or diced celery
6 ounces crab meat (can also use imitation crab meat)
6 cups cooked white rice (1 cup mixed in; 5 cups for serving gumbo over)
steps: Make a roux by heating oil and flour in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir constantly until flour is pecan-colored.
Add bell pepper, onion, garlic, celery leaves and 1 cup water.
Cover and cook on very low heat until vegetables are tender.
Increase heat to high, and add 3 cups water and 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth. Boil for 5 minutes.
Reduce to medium heat, and add shrimp and crab meat. Boil 10 minutes.
Add green onion tops and parsley.
Reduce to low heat, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup cooked rice.
Season with pepper and hot sauce.
Serve gumbo over hot rice.
shrimp-and-crab-gumbo.quickMethod: Make a roux by heating oil and flour in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir constantly until flour is pecan-colored. Add bell pepper, onion, garlic, celery leaves and 1 cup water.
shrimp-and-crab-gumbo.notes: Frozen shrimp are often high in sodium. WELL

ingredients: 5 cups cooked brown rice (cooked in unsalted water)
2 1/2 cups chicken breasts, cooked, skin and bone removed, diced
steps: In a large skillet, sauté onions and green peppers in oil for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Add tomato sauce and spices. Heat through.
Add cooked rice and chicken. Heat through.
chicken-and-spanish-rice.quickMethod: In a large skillet, sauté onions and green peppers in oil for 5 minutes on medium heat. Add tomato sauce and spices. Heat through.

ingredients: 4 ounces mushrooms, Crimini or button, washed and sliced
Pinch salt and pepper, to taste
steps: Heat grill to medium-high heat.
Mix all marinade ingredients and mix well. Place the chicken and marinade in a resealable bag. Marinate the chicken for 30 to 45 minutes.
Take chicken and let drain for a moment. Place on the grill to cook.
Sauté the onion and pepper in a separate pan. Cook for about 5 minutes, then add mushrooms. Cook until all vegetables are soft.
Turn chicken on the grill, cook until cooked thoroughly.
Put the chicken on the plate first and cover with the vegetables.
grilled-malt-chicken-with-peppers-and-on.quickMethod: Heat grill to medium-high heat. Mix all marinade ingredients and mix well. Place the chicken and marinade in a resealable bag. Marinate the chicken for 30 to 45 minutes.

ingredients: 8 bamboo skewers, 10 inches long, soaked in water for 30 minutes
steps: In a blender or mini food processor, process all marinade ingredients until smooth.
Toss shrimp with marinade in a bowl to coat well. Set aside at least 10 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Cut onion in half and each half into quarters.
Thread 1 chili onto each skewer. Add 1 shrimp and a chunk of onion; repeat twice. Finish each skewer with a second chili.
Heat a cast-iron grill pan or an electric or gas grill over high heat.
Cook skewers, covered, turning once, until shrimp are cooked through and onions are charred and just tender, about 5 minutes per side.
Serve with salsa.
summer-shrimp.quickMethod: In a blender or mini food processor, process all marinade ingredients until smooth. Toss shrimp with marinade in a bowl to coat well. Set aside at least 10 minutes or up to 2 hours.
summer-shrimp.notes: If using metal skewers, spray with a vegetable oil cooking spray. If using a charcoal grill, be sure to adjust cooking time because the shrimp will cook faster. Frozen shrimp are often high in sodium.

ingredients: 4 4-ounce flat iron steaks Coffee-Ancho Chile Rub (see recipe on page 105)
steps: Generously rub steaks with spice rub and let sit for 30 minutes before cooking.
Cook to your preferred doneness.
Take from pan, but leave the pan on the burner and add the stock.
Mix cornstarch and water.
Bring the stock to a quick boil, add the cornstarch slurry and whisk. The stock will thicken quickly; remove from heat and serve over the steak.
quickIngredients: 4 4-ounce flat iron steaks Coffee-Ancho Chile Rub (see recipe on page 105)
coffee-ancho-chile-rubbed-flat-iron-stea.quickMethod: Generously rub steaks with spice rub and let sit for 30 minutes before cooking. Cook to your preferred doneness.
coffee-ancho-chile-rubbed-flat-iron-stea.servingSuggestion: Serve with potato and vegetable side dishes from the Sides section starting on page 62.

ingredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups chicken stock (see recipe on page 108)
8 ounces button mushrooms, washed and sliced
1/4 pound broccoli florets, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat chicken stock.
Prep vegetables and measure out dry goods. Once the stock comes to a boil, remove from heat and set aside.
Heat olive oil in medium-size saucepan; add onion, mushrooms and garlic. Sauté until onions become soft.
Add the risotto and the rice and cook for a few minutes.
Add the wine and reduce by half.
Add 1 cup of the hot stock; stir rice continuously as it absorbs the stock. Continue adding more stock and stirring.
After all stock is added, mix in the broccoli.
After the stock is absorbed and the rice is tender, add Parmesan cheese and season to taste.
quickIngredients: 2 - 2 1/2 cups chicken stock (see recipe on page 108)
8 ounces button mushrooms, washed and sliced
mushroom-and-broccoli-risotto.quickMethod: Heat chicken stock. Prep vegetables and measure out dry goods. Once the stock comes to a boil, remove from heat and set aside.

ingredients: 1 pint fresh strawberries, stemmed and sliced
2 tablespoons granulated sugar or to taste
1 pint light or reduced-fat strawberry ice cream
steps: Toss strawberries, sugar, juice and rind in a bowl; set aside.
Put scoops of sorbet and ice cream in 4 deep bowls or parfait glasses.
Top with a layer of sauce; repeat with another layer of sorbet and ice cream.
Top with remaining sauce, crumbs and ginger.
quickIngredients: 1 pint fresh strawberries, stemmed and sliced
2 tablespoons granulated sugar or to taste
strawberry-mango-parfaits-with-ginger-to.quickMethod: Toss strawberries, sugar, juice and rind in a bowl; set aside. Put scoops of sorbet and ice cream in 4 deep bowls or parfait glasses.

ingredients: 1 cup blanched almond flour, sifted Sprinkle of sea salt (1/4 teaspoon or less to taste)
1/4 cup (or more for extra chocolatey goodness) Enjoy Life Chocolate Chips or chopped dark chocolate (70-85 percent or higher)
steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Mix almond flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl or stand mixer; mix thoroughly.
Mix liquid ingredients in a medium mixing bowl.
Slowly add liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients, mixing well until combined.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Spoon onto prepared baking sheet and bake for 10 to 11 minutes or until golden brown around the edges.
quickIngredients: 1 cup blanched almond flour, sifted Sprinkle of sea salt (1/4 teaspoon or less to taste)
chocolate-chip-cookies.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Mix almond flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl or stand mixer; mix thoroughly.

ingredients: 4 cups fresh strawberries, remove stems and quarter
1 lime, cut into 6 to 8 wedges N
steps: Mash or puree 1 cup of the quartered strawberries until mostly smooth.
Beat the whipping cream with the sugar and lime zest until very stiff.
Fold the mashed strawberries into the whipped cream.
Layer the cream mixture and remaining strawberries in six 6- to 7-ounce glasses or dishes.
Top each portion with a lime wedge. Serve right away, or cover and chill for up to 2 hours.
quickIngredients: 4 cups fresh strawberries, remove stems and quarter
strawberry-lime-dessert.quickMethod: Mash or puree 1 cup of the quartered strawberries until mostly smooth. Beat the whipping cream with the sugar and lime zest until very stiff.

steps: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor; blend until well mixed.
Serve with your favorite fresh fruit such as pineapple, pears and strawberries.
light-and-creamy-cranberry-fresh-fruit-d.quickMethod: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor; blend until well mixed. Serve with your favorite fresh fruit such as pineapple, pears and strawberries.

ingredients: 1 12-ounce bag frozen unsweetened blackberries, thawed (or 3 half-pint containers of fresh blackberries)
1 8-ounce container light or reduced-fat whipped cream
steps: Heat oven to 350° F.
Lightly grease an 8-inch square baking dish.
In large saucepan, combine blackberries and sugar, let stand for 30 minutes.
Cook blackberries and sugar mixture, stirring frequently, over medium heat for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and water until blended.
Stir cornstarch mixture into blackberry mixture.
Bring to boil over medium heat; boil for 1 minute or until mixture is thickened.
Spoon mixture into pan.
In a medium bowl, combine brown sugar, oats, flour and cinnamon.
Using a pastry blender or fork, cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle evenly over blackberry mixture.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.
Serve with a dollop of whipped cream.
quickIngredients: 1 12-ounce bag frozen unsweetened blackberries, thawed (or 3 half-pint containers of fresh blackberries)
blackberry-cobbler.quickMethod: Heat oven to 350° F. Lightly grease an 8-inch square baking dish.

ingredients: 1 bag (12 ounces) cranberries, fresh or frozen and thawed
1 1/4 cups egg whites (from about 9 large eggs), at room temperature
steps: Cake: Heat oven to 325° F.
Beat egg whites and salt in a bowl with an electric mixer on medium until frothy, about 2 minutes.
Add cream of tartar. Beat until soft peaks form, about 5 minutes.
Increase speed to high. Add 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, until whites form soft, glossy peaks.
Beat in vanilla and lemon juice.
In another bowl, mix remaining 1/2 cup sugar with flour.
Sift 1/3 sugar/flour mixture over egg whites; gently, but thoroughly, fold into batter using a large spatula. Repeat twice with remaining sugar/flour mixture.
Fold in dry coconut in 2 batches.
Scrape batter into an ungreased 10-inch angel food tube pan with a removable bottom.
Smooth top into even layer.
Bake 35 minutes or until top is lightly browned and cake springs back when you press it.
Turn pan upside down and rest on the neck of a glass bottle to cool.
Run a knife against insides of pan to loosen cake; remove pan. Loosen cake from bottom of pan; invert onto a plate.
Cover with plastic wrap. Store at room temperature or in the refrigerator.
Sauce: Boil all ingredients in a medium saucepan 1 minute, until lightly thickened.
Let cool.
Cover; refrigerate 1 hour.
Before serving, sprinkle top of cake with coconut shavings and cut into 12 slices. Serve slices with 3 tablespoons sauce.
coconut-angel-food-cake.quickMethod: Cake: Heat oven to 325° F. Beat egg whites and salt in a bowl with an electric mixer on medium until frothy, about 2 minutes.

ingredients: 15 ounces ricotta cheese (part-skim; whole can be used as well) Juice and zest of 1 medium lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Mix egg yolks, ricotta, lemon juice and zest, sugar substitute, vanilla and salt; stir to mix.
Test to make sure there is enough lemon flavor. If not, add more.
Fold egg whites into ricotta mixture and pour into greased pie pan.
Bake 25 minutes or until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Refrigerate until completely cool.
Cut into 8 piece and serve with fresh berries or your favorite topping.
quickIngredients: 15 ounces ricotta cheese (part-skim; whole can be used as well) Juice and zest of 1 medium lemon
lemon-ricotta-pie.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
lemon-ricotta-pie.servingSuggestion: Serving with berries, or other fruit, makes this a great dessert!

ingredients: 8 slices of bread or 2 large bagels
1 cup liquid nondairy low-fat or reduced-fat creamer
steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Spray a 1 1/2-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Break bread into small pieces and put in dish.
Mix creamer, egg substitute, sugar and cinnamon together and pour over bread.
Gently press with a fork so all the liquid is absorbed by the bread.
Bake for 30 minutes until brown on top.
quickIngredients: 8 slices of bread or 2 large bagels
1 cup liquid nondairy low-fat or reduced-fat creamer
bread-pudding.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Spray a 1 1/2-quart baking dish with cooking spray.

steps: Heat the oven to 400° F.
Spray muffin pan with cooking spray.
Mix bran, milk and sugar in another bowl and let stand 5 minutes.
Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon in a large bowl.
In the bowl with the bran, stir in egg and applesauce.
Add to flour mixture and stir until just moistened. Batter will be lumpy.
Spoon batter into muffin pan, filling each cup 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
bran-muffin.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 400° F. Spray muffin pan with cooking spray.

ingredients: 1 cup Splenda (sugar also can be used)
1 3/4 cup raw apple, peeled and cut into small pieces (other low-potassium fruit also can be used)
steps: Heat the oven to 400° F.
Grease muffin pan or use 12 muffin liners.
Beat eggs in a large bowl. Add Splenda or sugar, oil and water; mix well.
Add vanilla.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Stir flour mixture into egg mixture. Batter will be lumpy.
Fold in apple pieces.
Fill muffin cups three quarters full.
Mix remaining 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon with 1 teaspoon Splenda or sugar. Sprinkle on top of muffins.
Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
quickIngredients: 1 cup Splenda (sugar also can be used)
apple-muffin.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 400° F. Grease muffin pan or use 12 muffin liners.
apple-muffin.servingSuggestion: Pair with a glass of juice or fruit smoothie for breakfast, and you're off to a great start.

ingredients: 1 can (14 ounces) nonfat, sweetened, condensed milk
2 large eggs, yolks and whites separated
2 cups low-calorie whipped cream (such as Cool Whip)
steps: Heat the oven to 325° F.
For crust: Mix graham cracker crumbs with sugar and butter. Spread evenly over bottom and sides of a nonstick 9-inch pie pan, and bake 5 minutes. Remove from oven; let cool.
For filling: In a medium bowl, using a fork, beat milk, lime juice and zest. Add 1 whole egg and 2 egg yolks (reserve whites) and beat well. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, beat egg whites until foamy. After about 20 seconds, add cream of tartar. Fold whites into custard mixture and pour into partially baked crust.
Bake 45 to 60 minutes or until set. Let cool.
Cut into 10 slices and serve with whipped cream. Garnish with lime slices, if desired.
quickIngredients: 1 can (14 ounces) nonfat, sweetened, condensed milk
key-lime-pie.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 325° F. For crust: Mix graham cracker crumbs with sugar and butter. Spread evenly over bottom and sides of a nonstick 9-inch pie pan, and bake 5 minutes. Remove from oven; let cool.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons light whipped cream Lemon zest
steps: Fill pie crusts with yogurt, then light whipped cream.
Garnish with lemon zest.
zesty-lemon-tart.quickMethod: Fill pie crusts with yogurt, then light whipped cream. Garnish with lemon zest.
zesty-lemon-tart.servingSuggestion: You can substitute any yogurt. Try key lime yogurt with lime zest or strawberry yogurt with fresh strawberries on top. pices, preads nd Rubs Homemade Salt-Free Mexican Spice Mix 103 Homemade Mayonnaise 104 Coffee-Ancho Chile Rub 105 Simple Kebob Marinade 106 Roasted Garlic 107 Basic Chicken Stock 108 Homemade Salt-Free Mexican Spice Mix WELL

steps: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container.
Add a few tablespoons to chicken, lean ground beef or to add a Mexican flair to any dish.
homemade-salt-free-mexican-spice-mix.quickMethod: Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container. Add a few tablespoons to chicken, lean ground beef or to add a Mexican flair to any dish.
homemade-salt-free-mexican-spice-mix.notes: Try smoked paprika for a warm, smoky flavor.

ingredients: 1 large pasteurized egg at room temperature
A pinch or two of sugar, if desired
2 to 3 teaspoons fresh lemon juice (or white wine vinegar or a mix of the two)
steps: Put egg, 1/4 cup oil, dry mustard, salt and sugar (if desired) in blender, food processor or mixer. Mix thoroughly.
With mixer running, very slowly (this is key) drizzle in remaining oil, a few drops at a time, allowing the oil to be completely absorbed by the mixture before adding more.
After all of the oil is added and the mixture has emulsified (it will seem to thicken and get lighter), add lemon juice/vinegar, stirring with spoon to incorporate.
Chill for 1 to 2 hours and then serve. Mayonnaise will keep for about a week in the refrigerator.
quickIngredients: 1 large pasteurized egg at room temperature
homemade-mayonnaise.quickMethod: Put egg, 1/4 cup oil, dry mustard, salt and sugar (if desired) in blender, food processor or mixer. Mix thoroughly. With mixer running, very slowly (this is key) drizzle in remaining oil, a few drops at a time, allowing the oil to be completely absorbed by the mixture before adding more.
homemade-mayonnaise.notes: Because a raw egg is used, only use the freshest grade A or AA eggs with intact shells. Ideally, use shell eggs that have been pasteurized or otherwise treated to destroy salmonella.

ingredients: 1/4 cup espresso coffee beans, finely ground
steps: Grind coffee beans to a fine consistency.
Take from grinder and place in a small mixing bowl.
Put the rest of the ingredients into the bowl and mix well.
This can be stored in a baggy or an airtight container.
quickIngredients: 1/4 cup espresso coffee beans, finely ground
coffee-ancho-chile-rub.quickMethod: Grind coffee beans to a fine consistency. Take from grinder and place in a small mixing bowl.
coffee-ancho-chile-rub.servingSuggestion: To be used with beef or lamb.

steps: Mix all ingredients together, adding oil last.
Marinate meat (chicken, pork, lean beef) or vegetables (onions, mushrooms, bell peppers, tomatoes, squash, cauliflower and more) overnight.
Grill or broil.
simple-kebob-marinade.quickMethod: Mix all ingredients together, adding oil last. Marinate meat (chicken, pork, lean beef) or vegetables (onions, mushrooms, bell peppers, tomatoes, squash, cauliflower and more) overnight.
simple-kebob-marinade.notes: Use 8 tablespoons of marinade for every 1 pound of meat. This recipe is enough for 2 pounds.

steps: Heat the oven to 350° F.
Take skin from garlic heads, leaving cloves intact.
Cut top off each head. Put heads in a small baking dish and add water to cover the bottom (about 1/4 inch).
Cover with a lid or foil.
Bake for 60 minutes or until cloves are soft to the touch.
roasted-garlic.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 350° F. Take skin from garlic heads, leaving cloves intact.
roasted-garlic.servingSuggestion: To eat, squeeze the large end of the clove until it pops out. Use as a spread on bread, substitute for mayonnaise on a sandwich, or as a topping for pizza or baked potato. Leftover cloves will keep in a sealed container in the refrigerator for about a week.

steps: Heat the oven to 400° F.
Wash the chicken bones and place them in a bowl with 2 tablespoons olive oil to coat the bones.
Put the bones on a sheet tray or suitable roasting pan and place in the oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Put a gallon-size stock pot on the stove top with 1 tablespoon olive oil and heat on high.
Add onion, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaves and peppercorns to the stock pot and sauté for 10 minutes.
Add the bones and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer.
Simmer the stock for 45 minutes and then strain into a heat-resistant container.
basic-chicken-stock.quickMethod: Heat the oven to 400° F. Wash the chicken bones and place them in a bowl with 2 tablespoons olive oil to coat the bones.
basic-chicken-stock.servingSuggestion: When cooled, you can store the chicken stock for 1 week in the refrigerator or up to 6 months in the freezer.
